author: David LaPorte
releaseNotes: Motion: the camera's PIR sensors now drive a motion attribute (MotionSensor), pushed over the camera's event stream, with a Motion inactive after setting (default 30 s). New commands and attributes for motion light duration, night vision and video motion detection, and a Reboot command with a quiet 5-minute window. A poll already under way no longer undoes a change the camera just confirmed. After updating, click Initialize on the device to start motion events. HomeKit: if the Home app shows the floodlight as a motion sensor, open HomeKit Bridge and click Switch next to Export as; if the device was in HomeKit before, remove it from HomeKit Bridge and add it back for the motion sensor to work. Requires Hubitat 2.2.9+.
